subject: Spatial Thining is taking a longer time and even after 1 hour the thining is going on

messages.author: 2ae23490bf87e8a2
messages.subject: Spatial Thining is taking a longer time and even after 1 hour the thining is going on
parts:
Hello, 

I'm trying to spatial thin a data which has 2638 occurrences but the spThin in the Wallace is taking very long time and its still not thinning it. The process is going on even after one hour. Is there any possible solution to it?

messages.author: fa55958de2726b1e
messages.subject: Re: Spatial Thining is taking a longer time and even after 1 hour the thining is going on
parts:
Yeah, unfortunately, that isn't unheard of. The spThin process can take a very long time at the moment for a large number of occurrences, especially if they are densely packed. I'm hoping to update the algorithm to go a lot faster this summer.

Matt A-L

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: Spatial Thining is taking a longer time and even after 1 hour the thining is going on
parts:
A workaround is to make a couple of subsets of your data, thin each subset individually, then put them back together and thin them again. This should be a lot quicker, but takes some time to set up.

Jamie
